name: Alper Türkeli
career_history: Associate Director at Turner & Townsend, 5/2025 to present
notes: Works at an adjacent-industry company (GC / energy / civil / industrial); re-imported 2026-09-09 at Siddhi's request.
biography: Alper has been with Turnaround 1000 for 5 years, currently serving as a regional cost lead for a fast-growing region across Nebraska, Iowa, and Kansas City, overseeing 32-33 hyperscale data center projects and managing 10 senior cost managers and 5 cost managers. He holds a Bachelor's in Civil Engineering from Bozcuç University in Turkey and an MBA in the US on a full scholarship. His career started as a cost analyst at a logistics company, followed by a role as an industrial engineer at Unified Rubber, focusing on cost reduction. He spent 3 years as a Project Manager at a subcontractor company, gaining project management experience. He then worked as a cost analyst at MasTech (telecommunication company), where he increased average monthly billings by over 220% and was promoted to project control supervisor. At Turner and Townsend, he supported Google's hyperscale data center portfolio across APEC, EMEA, LATAM, and North America for more than 160 projects, managing programs valued at over $30 billion. His responsibilities included standardization, governance, operational consistencies, identifying and resolving discrepancies, rolling out new processes, and conducting training. In his regional cost lead role, he manages project controls deliverables during pre-construction, partners with development, estimating, controls, and construction teams, leads estimate review sessions, challenges assumptions, benchmarks cost drivers, evaluates value engineering opportunities and contingencies, and provides an independent project controls perspective. He leads discussions with leadership for funding and presents executive-level slide decks based on detailed estimate reviews. He focuses on understanding the basis of estimates and cost drivers rather than direct supplier/vendor interaction. Alper is open to new opportunities despite being happy in his current role, motivated by a transition to the owner side from consultancy and is progressing to a final in-person interview with another major international data center company.
